changelog.title: Morning forecast — a schedule of its own

sections.title: What's new
items: The host can run the forecast for you each morning: schedule "Morning forecast" on the Schedule page and the app answers one line — the active place, the sky, and a verdict per decision card — without spending an AI call.
The app suggests that schedule once, after the first real forecast; nothing runs until you say so.

sections.title: What's new
items: The forecast app is unchanged; its wiki gains new lessons and next-tasks pages.
Taking this update lands the full doc set in copies installed before doc seeding existed.

sections.title: What's new
items: Forecasts turned into decisions — run, ride, water, or wait.
Live forecast data through your own API key, stored only in your file.
